title: Smart Cart POS — RFID + Raspberry Pi
description: An executable POS system built with VB.NET, running on a Raspberry Pi synced to the cloud. Shoppers scan any RFID-tagged product at the cart-mounted reader to see product code, description, unit price, quantity and running totals in real time. A built-in aisle-locator helps users find items, checkout happens via an auto-generated QR code, and the receipt is emailed automatically.
